dataset.registration_status: registered TIFF/JSON pair; STL excluded as unregistered

accuracy_score_reason: No released or hidden per-strut ground-truth labels are available in the evaluated artifacts/repository for a registered truth join. Candidate counts must not be interpreted as confirmed missing or disconnected struts.
evidence: inspection_summary.json records TIFF/registered JSON paths, volume shape, selected threshold 38197, seven representative Otsu thresholds, and candidate counts.
strut_candidates.csv contains one record per expected strut with material_fraction, longest_gap_samples, flag, and voxel coordinates.
threshold_candidates.csv records the tested thresholds and separation/clear-fraction trade-offs.
README.md explicitly says candidates require review and the STL is excluded because it is unregistered.
interpretation: The run is a strong, traceable registered candidate screen. Its 44.05% automated flagged-candidate rate exceeds the 0.5% nominal missing-strut variant, but this is not a measured defect rate: flags include disconnected candidates and may include threshold/segmentation artifacts. The documented possibility that measured defects exceed nominal does not validate this discrepancy.
next_validation_step: Obtain registered per-strut truth or perform blinded CT-neighborhood adjudication, then compute class-specific precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, and percentage error.
